When they tell you know “we are just here to augment humans, not replace them”, they are saying what they want you to hear for PR, not what they actually believe or hope.

Here’s how you can tell. 

The total addressable market for augmenting humans is probably in the high billions.

yes, absolutely, many companies are experimenting.

Looks like I'm not the only one asking "What are all those tokens actually producing?".

But I don't think this is like the dotcom era. I think companies are just spending this money *experimenting*, trying to figure out what they can do with AI agents. It's temporary.

- OpenAI will struggle

- Google will catch up to Anthropic 
- some Chinese companies might, too
- LLMs will become commodities; margins will be very very thin 
- Most of the companies that invested massively in them will struggle to make back their investments
- SpaceX’s AI efforts will flail
